info.title: MonKado API
info.description: Versioned Go API. Timestamps are UTC; nullable properties are always serialized.

post.summary: Resolve one explicitly selected product image.
post.description: Requires an authenticated owner of an active wishlist. Downloads only the submitted image through the public-only transport, without analyzing a product page or persisting data. Destinations and every redirect are validated; source bytes and image dimensions are bounded.

200.description: Normalized image selected by the member.

422.description: The selected image could not be retrieved or decoded.

get.description: Private groups require accepted membership. Invitations never grant list access. All accepted members may invite and read pending invitations. Only owners rename/delete groups, revoke invitations and remove other members. Each list owner explicitly shares their own lists. All accesses are rechecked server-side; removal, leaving, archive and suspension revoke group-derived access. Public links and subscriptions remain independent. Reservations use global quantities, disclose no other participant identities and are unavailable to the list owner through group routes. Owners use their existing wishlist view. Mutations are atomic; reads never enroll or reserve. Invitations expire after 14 days. Group limit: 100 members including pending invitations; member limit: 50 groups.

403.description: Accepted member is not the owner

404.description: Absent, expired or private foreign resource

get.description: Private groups require accepted membership. Invitations never grant list access. All accepted members may invite and read pending invitations. Only owners rename/delete groups, revoke invitations and remove other members. Each list owner explicitly shares their own lists. get.description: Any accepted member may read or explicitly create the shared join link. Only the owner may revoke it with its current ETag. Reading never creates a link or membership. Codes are random, hashed for lookup and purpose-bound encrypted at rest. An authenticated holder explicitly joins via POST without organizer approval. Joining locks membership/capacity atomically, consumes any pending named invitation, and preserves independent sharing. Revocation invalidates the link, code and QR immediately for new joins; existing memberships remain. No join code is returned by public reads. Named invitations still require recipient acceptance.

Public lists (active public share link) are visible by default in all current and future owner groups, except explicitly unchecked groups. Private lists require explicit grants. Images and reservation access use the same effective visibility.

post.description: Requires authenticated current group membership and current access to the source wishlist. Source membership and effective audience are rechecked under parent locks. The destination must be owned, active and unsuspended. Creation is explicit and returns an independent wish and image with new identifiers and version; favorites and reservations are not copied. Does not create a public sharing link, participation or reservation. Revoked membership, hidden or archived/suspended sources and foreign source children return 404. Destination conflicts and capacity limits return 409. Image copying uses the same bounded admission, hash verification and atomic database/file lifecycle as owned and publicly shared copies.
